codeReview.summary: The worker correctly identified all blocking issues during `make check` (stale AGENTS.md references to deleted `agent_host/` and `worker/`, broken docs links to deleted `historical/index.md`, orphaned phase notes in docs graph, and frontend AGENTS.md path resolution in freshness validator). All fixes are correct, minimal, and well-scoped. The `make test` and `make check` passes were confirmed. All three verification steps from the feature spec are satisfied: `fleet-rlm chat --help` exits 0, `make test` passes, `make check` passes.

issues.description: The for/else loop that searches subdirs sets `subdir_path` to a non-None value only when `break` is called (i.e., when `subdir_path.exists()` is already True). The subsequent `if subdir_path and subdir_path.exists()` check is therefore redundant — `subdir_path.exists()` is always True when `subdir_path` is not None here. This is harmless but adds noise.

Stale backtick-wrapped path reference `src/fleet_rlm/agent_host/` remains in the 'Source of Truth' prose section. It was not updated in this commit. The worker correctly identified this as a non-blocking discovered issue (it is not caught by any existing validator — `check_docs_quality.py` only checks markdown links, and `check_agents_md_freshness.py` only checks AGENTS.md files). Not a blocker for this feature, but a lingering stale reference.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `check_agents_md_freshness.py` validator's path-resolution logic for AGENTS.md files outside the repo root was undocumented and broken for the Node.js frontend case. The fix (add `package.json` detection + subdir candidates for `src`, `src/components`, `src/lib`, `src/features`) is now in the code, but there is no documentation of this behavior in `.factory/library/` or in the script's own module docstring. Future workers touching `src/frontend/AGENTS.md` or the freshness check script could rediscover this same issue.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: scripts/check_agents_md_freshness.py lines 167-171 — `package.json` branch newly added; `.factory/library/` has no entry about this quirk

sharedStateObservations.observation: The docs quality check (`check_docs_quality.py`) does not validate backtick-wrapped path references in documentation prose — only markdown-style hyperlinks. This means stale backtick paths (like `src/fleet_rlm/agent_host/` in docs/index.md:42) are invisible to all validators. This gap could allow stale references to accumulate silently. The `check_agents_md_freshness.py` validator does check backtick paths, but only in AGENTS.md files, not in docs/*.md.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: docs/index.md:42 contains `src/fleet_rlm/agent_host/` but both validators pass. Worker noted this as a discovered non-blocking issue in handoff.

summary: Pass. The worker correctly handled all cross-area integration issues: AGENTS.md updated to remove stale references to deleted directories, broken docs links to `historical/index.md` removed from docs/README.md and docs/index.md, 11 previously-orphaned phase notes added to SUMMARY.md, and the AGENTS.md freshness validator extended to correctly resolve paths for the Node.js frontend project.
